claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is compliant and adequately supported despite the procurement invoice review segment missing target, because aggregate launch readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, and the limitation can be documented and monitored without treating it as a material weakness requiring resolved disclosure or approved risk acceptance before launch.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence shows both launch-readiness support and satisfaction of the release-policy disclosure/risk-acceptance requirement.
A named launch use case or contractual customer segment makes the weakness material under the provided policy text.
Open legal review does not cure the policy predicate.
Aggregate pass status and absence of severity-one incidents support readiness, but do not by themselves resolve materiality or disclosure obligations.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual disclosure decision or launch documentation showing the limitation was disclosed for the named launch use case before launch.
Provide any approved pre-launch risk acceptance covering this gap.
Provide the legal review outcome on whether disclosure is required.
Provide the underlying customer commitment records showing whether the affected segment is in fact a named launch use case or contractual customer segment.
specific_concerns: The admissible summary supports launch-readiness indicators, but not the required policy predicate for omitting material weakness treatment.
The affected procurement invoice review segment is described as a named use case in enterprise rollout commitments, which weighs toward materiality under the policy text.
Legal review on whether the gap must be disclosed is still open, and the policy text says pending legal review does not resolve materiality.
No admissible evidence is provided that the material limitation was disclosed before launch or that an approved risk acceptance exists.
The actor's packet itself says the evidentiary basis for omitting a material weakness disclosure is limited.
unsupported_claims: That certification is fully policy-compliant on the present record.
That the weakness can be treated as non-material based on non-core or aggregate-readiness framing.
That documentation and monitoring alone satisfy the release policy absent resolved disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
